description: This file contains test cases for user-related API endpoints in a FastAPI-based service, including functions to create users, generate keys, and verify user permissions and isolation. It uses pytest and asyncio to run asynchronous tests, and includes detailed test scenarios for user creation, key generation, access control, and budget management.

classes.name: AsyncOpenAI
classes.description: An external class from openai for asynchronous API calls to OpenAI services

methods.name: new_user( session, i, user_id=None, budget=None, budget_duration=None, models=None )
methods.description: Creates a new user via the API, returning user info including user_id and key.

methods.description: Generates a new API key with specified parameters like models, budget, and metadata.

methods.name: test_user_new()
methods.description: Tests the creation of multiple users concurrently.

methods.name: get_user_info(session, get_user, call_user, view_all: Optional[bool] = None)
methods.description: Fetches information about a user, optionally viewing all models.

methods.name: test_user_info()
methods.description: Verifies user info retrieval both as admin and as the user itself.

methods.name: test_user_update()
methods.description: Placeholder for testing user update functionalities.

methods.name: test_users_budgets_reset()
methods.description: Checks that user budgets reset appropriately after specified durations.

methods.name: chat_completion(session, key, model="gpt-4")
methods.description: Performs a chat completion request using the OpenAI client with specified model.

methods.name: test_global_proxy_budget_update()
methods.description: Tests spend logging and updating via API calls for proxy budget.

methods.name: test_user_model_access()
methods.description: Checks model access restrictions based on user permissions.

methods.name: Tuple[Dict,Dict] setup_test_users(session: aiohttp.ClientSession)
methods.description: Creates two test users and an additional key for one, for setup in further tests.

methods.name: None print_response_details(response: aiohttp.ClientResponse)
methods.description: Helper to print detailed response information from API calls.

methods.description: Verifies that a user cannot update another user's key.

methods.name: test_key_delete_user_isolation()
methods.description: Verifies that a user cannot delete another user's key.
